recognize_zh: 皮膚低倍切片：表皮呈不規則棘皮增生、表皮釘突延長，真皮乳頭層與淺層被帶狀（band-like）密集小淋巴球浸潤填滿，並緊貼真表皮交界，這種淺層帶狀浸潤是蕈狀肉芽腫（mycosis fungoides）斑塊期的低倍樣式。
features: Irregular acanthosis with elongated, club-shaped rete ridges and overlying parakeratotic scale
Dense band-like infiltrate of small lymphocytes filling the papillary and superficial dermis
Infiltrate abuts the dermal-epidermal junction without a grenz zone
Lymphocytes appear to extend into the lower epidermis, but epidermotropism is not resolvable at this power
Papillary dermal fibrosis not clearly assessable owing to image quality
describe_en: Low-power view of a skin biopsy shows irregular psoriasiform acanthosis with elongated rete ridges and overlying compact scale. A dense, band-like lymphoid infiltrate fills the papillary and superficial reticular dermis and abuts the dermal-epidermal junction without an intervening grenz zone. Individual cytology and the degree of epidermotropism cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The pattern is compatible with plaque-stage mycosis fungoides; high-power assessment for epidermotropic atypical lymphocytes and Pautrier microabscesses, immunophenotyping, and TCR clonality are needed.

ddx.dx: Lichenoid dermatitis (lichen planus, lichenoid drug reaction)
ddx.vs: Lichenoid dermatitis shows basal vacuolar damage, Civatte bodies, and wedge-shaped hypergranulosis with non-atypical lymphocytes, rather than atypical lymphocytes lining the basal layer.
These have a sparse perivascular infiltrate with spongiosis or neutrophils in scale, not a dense lymphoid band with epidermotropism disproportionate to spongiosis.
B-cell infiltrates are usually nodular and deeper with a grenz zone, whereas MF is band-like and epidermotropic.
